content: Ngwiiyà a Yɛsu
Ungö a saba, u nsɛmà a ilä atàtwɛb kyà mpɔsà, Màlye un'nsi Magàdalà anà Màlye wumwɛy, bàkyen mukàler an'dii.
Kà imbürà, mɛɛn laa màtɛɛr ma ngwal: un'kyeey a Mwol kàfü du, waa kàbuum nkɔŋ anà kàbwaay udu aya.
Nde kàkäl asànaa munyä, ipfɛy ande byàkäl byàpɛɛl asànaa für.
Aseey bàwem bɔɔmà mbɔɔn, waa bàbulà asànaa baar aŋàkwà.
Wɛɛ un'kyeey kàtɛn a akaar aban naa: « Bɛ, bɛ twon lan'man bɔɔmà. Mɛ, mɛ in'kyàyöb naa bɛ làwàmuleŋ Yɛsu awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi.
Nde apà watɛy, nde kan'wiyà kukwà asànaa kàtɛn nde. Yää, làmɛn ikal kàkäl nde aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Làkyen agyä, kàlakyään alɔŋki ande naa: "Nde kàkyàwiyà uboo a akü, nde kan'fwel u Ngalilɛ, bɛ làyàkuman kwo." Le, mɛ amàlakyään. »
Làgyägyä, ba bàlwomà kan'dii u ntiin bàŋàyɔl a bɔɔmà anà un'sak mbɔɔn, waa bàkàkyään alɔŋki ande.
Umbalà mwɛy, Yɛsu kàyàbwey anà ba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mbɔr abɛ! » Ba bàsin tsütsü apà nde, bun'tɛ mpi kà in'kɔl, waa bun'kömà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Twon lan'man bɔɔmà. Kàlakyään atɔŋ amɛ bàkyen Ngalilɛ: ba bàyan'man kwo. »
Ndaa bàtɛn aseey a an'dii
Mpal bàkäl akaar u mbwo, amwɛy uboo aseey a an'dii bayi u bul, waa bàkyään amfum a angaŋ ndaa yanswà yàlyaŋ.
Amfum a angaŋ bàköŋ anà andweer, waa bàpɛ ngim mbɔɔn akà aŋità,
waa baswɛŋ naa: « Bɛ làyàtɛn naa: "Bi kàkäl bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u mpib, alɔŋki ande waa bàyun'yib."
Kya isàkal naa kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kan'yöb ya, bi ikyer ayun'kwaam mpem ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndaa. »
Ba bàwɛl ngim ayin, waa bàläb ndaa yanswà baswɛŋ amfum a angaŋ anà andweer. Làsaŋ a ndaa ayi làkyàpää akà Ayudà tii ŋàbawà.
Yɛsu kan'tɔm alɔŋki ande mukàsal
Alɔŋki bàkwem aŋimwɛy bàkyen Ngalilɛ, udu a mɔŋ kaswɛŋ Yɛsu.
Mpal bun'mɛn ba, laa bun'kömà ba. Wɛɛ bumwɛy uboo aba bàkyey anki naa awà nde.
Yɛsu kàsin tsütsü apà ba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ikɔ̈b kyanswà bàkyan'pà u du anà u mɛɛn.
Làkyen akà in'sɛŋ myanswà, labuul alɔŋki, ladümà kà ikɔb a Taa, anà kyà Mwan, anà kyà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl,
anà lalɔŋ mukyer ndaa yanswà kàlaswɛŋ mɛ. Wɛɛ akà mɛ, mɛ in'wà anà bɛ ilä byanswà tii u ntsüü a mɛɛn. »
